item.title: BVI Vacation Without Sailing Experience: Best Yacht Charter Options for Beginners
item.description: Picture waking up to the sound of waves against the hull of a catamaran anchored in a secluded cove in the British Virgin Islands (BVI). Walk on deck and soak up the sunshine and the spectacular views this area is famous for. It’s the perfect holiday, and the best part is that no sailing experience is needed. With Dream Yacht Worldwide , you can enjoy a BVI yacht vacation without having to know a jib from a mainsail. We make sailing accessible to all, with three options especially suited for beginners: Easy Crew, Skippered, and Cabin Cruises. Can You Go on a BVI Vacation Without Sailing Experience? Many people assume that exploring the ocean requires a formal captain’s license or a deep understanding of marine navigation. While renting a boat entirely on your own, known as a bareboat charter , requires sailing experience, there are plenty of ways to enjoy the sea without any technical knowledge. With a crewed BVI sailing vacation , you don’t need to stress about managing a vessel. Our team oversees managing the necessary tasks, such as tracking the weather, anchoring in a busy bay, or interpreting complex nautical terms. You’ll have experienced staff managing onboard systems for you while you enjoy the experience. Our modern catamarans are also stable boats, which means a very low risk of motion sickness and a comfortable stay for those new to life on the water. Best BVI Charter Options If You Don’t Know How to Sail Every traveler has a different preference when it comes to privacy, budget, and daily schedules. Dream Yacht Worldwide provides three distinct entry points designed to match your personal style. Best For Privacy Level Meals Budget Skippered Charter Families and friend groups High (Full private yacht) Cook your own meals or dine ashore Mid to High Easy Crewed Charter Milestone trips and relaxation seekers High (Full private yacht) Half or full board cooked by a host Premium Cabin Cruise Couples, solo travelers, and budget travelers Private cabin, shared deck Set meal plan included in the price Affordable BVI Skippered Yacht Charters: Ultimate Freedom and Privacy A skippered charter means you rent an entire yacht for your group and hire a professional captain to sail it. You have total control over your daily schedule, allowing you to choose exactly when to sail and which bays to visit. The captain handles all the physical labor, anchoring, and navigation, while you and your guests enjoy the exclusive use of the boat. A BVI catamaran charter with skipper is ideal for families who want to cook their own meals or try local beachside restaurants every night. BVI Crewed Yacht Charters: The Effortless Private Getaway If you want the ultimate luxury of a private boat combined with the service of an all-inclusive resort, consider an Easy Crewed charter . Along with a professional captain, you get a dedicated onboard host/cook to manage the galley and handle tasks like grocery shopping (provisioning) or cooking meals during your stay. Cabin Cruises: The Budget-Friendly Entry Point to Sailing A Cabin Cruise is a smart choice for those who want to experience the yachting lifestyle without renting an entire boat. You can book an individual, private cabin with its own bathroom on a large, modern catamaran. The journey follows a pre-planned route, and meals are prepared and served by the crew. Think of it as staying at a boutique hotel that drops anchor at a different, beautiful spot every day. Why the BVI Is Ideal for First-Time Yacht Vacations The British Virgin Islands are widely considered the sailing capital of the Caribbean. The unique geography of the region creates a gentle, welcoming environment for anyone new to the water. Line-of-Sight Navigation and Calm Waters One of the biggest comfort factors in the BVI is that you can almost always see the next island on the horizon. Because the islands form a protected channel, the water remains remarkably calm and sheltered from large ocean swells. This visual navigation removes…

item.title: What’s a Cabin Cruise? Everything You Need to Know Before Booking
item.description: Imagine waking up to the sound of water gently lapping against the hull, stepping outside, and diving straight into a clear, turquoise ocean. For a long time, enjoying a holiday like this meant you either needed a lifetime of sailing experience or the budget to rent a whole private vessel with a captain. Now, travelers can book a cabin cruise and experience the magic of a sailing vacation to an exotic destination for the price of a single hotel room. Even better, sailing experience is not required. You simply book your cabin, step aboard, and leave the work to the crew on board the yacht. Before you pack your bags and head for the marina, here is everything you need to know about this effortless way to explore the world. What Is a Cabin Cruise? A cabin cruise, also called a by-the-cabin sailing charter , is a style of travel where you rent a private stateroom or cabin on a yacht. The rest of the vessel is shared with a small group of like-minded travelers, so you have opportunities to socialize in between exploring islands and relaxing in your room. Every cabin charter trip features a carefully planned route, shared communal spaces, delicious meals, and a professional crew to run the ship. It’s an easy way to dip your toes into the yachting lifestyle. What Is a Cabin Charter Like? The entire travel process is designed to be stress-free from the moment you book your cabin cruise vacation to the day you head home. Choosing Your Destination and Dates Your journey begins by selecting where you want to sail and picking the dates that fit your schedule. These trips follow set itineraries, which you can view ahead of time. This way, you can see which ports you’ll visit and plan ahead of time. Arrival and Boarding When you arrive at the marina base, the crew will welcome you aboard and show you to your private stateroom. After a quick safety briefing and an introduction to the yacht, the captain casts off the lines and sets sail. Your Cruise Each day follows a relaxing rhythm of sailing, swimming, exploring hidden coves, and enjoying fresh meals on deck. While the captain handles the sailing, you share the spacious decks with your fellow passengers. Do You Need Sailing Experience? With this type of sailing vacation, no experience is required. You do not need to know how to tie a single knot, read a navigation chart, or handle a steering wheel. The price of your cabin includes the services of the captain and crew. They take care of navigation, weather tracking, anchoring, and all daily shipboard operations. The only thing you need to do the entire week is relax and have fun. What’s Included in a Cabin Yacht Charter? Inclusions vary based on the package you choose and the company you book with. Premium options, such as Dream Yacht ’s cabin cruises, typically include: A private, comfortable double cabin with its own bathroom Access to all shared yacht spaces, like the forward trampolines, salon, and sun decks The full services of a professional captain and cook Onboard water toys, which may include things like snorkeling gear, paddleboards, and kayaks Before booking, be sure to check the trip details to confirm inclusions and what you might need to cover during your cruise. Food, Beverages, and Culinary Options Many packages offer a half-board plan, which includes select meals such as breakfast and lunch. With half-board options, you may dine ashore at ports where you drop anchor. Other packages feature a full-board plan, which means breakfast, lunch, and dinner are included. Optional Excursions and Extras Depending on where you are sailing, you might have the option to add on excursions like guided island hikes and historical tours. It is always a good idea to check your specific package details before booking, so you know exactly what is covered and what extras you might want to explore. item.title: Find Out Our Facebook Community’s Top Destinations to Visit in 2019
item.description: The results are in after we asked our awesome Facebook community their top 10 destinations for 2019. We asked, and you told us! After hundreds of votes, we can now reveal the top 10 destinations as chosen by you. Italy We head to Europe for a touch of Italian charm. As well as wonderful, year-long warm weather, Italy is famed for its mouth-watering cuisine that will make your sailing adventure a tasty one! Head to Poseidon in the Bay of Naples where you’ll discover some of the most flavorsome foods you’ll ever eat, then head to the Pontine and Phlegraean Islands, as well as Capri, Sorrento and the Amalfi Coast. Or, sail to Sardinia with its renowned La Maddalena archipelago and miles of beautiful coastline, and Sicily , where you can see Europe’s largest active volcano, Mount Etna and sail the Aeolian and Egadi Islands. Greece You voted for Greece , where we have eight exciting bases for you to discover the Ionian and Aegean seas and the Cyclades, Dodecanese, Sporades and Ionian island groups. If you like island hopping, where there are over one thousand islands to choose from, then a Greek sailing vacation will be perfect for you. Discover amazing ancient legacies and architecture in Athens and Rhodes, relax on the beaches in Paros and Halki Island and marvel at the blue domes in Santorini on a yacht charter vacation you’ll never forget. France You voted France as a top destination to visit in 2019. Head south to the popular celebrity haunt, the Cote d’Azur on the French Riviera, where you’ll enjoy warm predictable weather, palm tree-lined beaches and clear cobalt water, which is excellent for snorkeling and diving. Bahamas We head to the islands of the Bahamas, where pigs don’t fly…but they do swim! With two bases to choose from, sailing the Bahamas has never been easier. Set sail from Palm Cay Marina, Nassau, to explore the islands of the Exumas , famous for its swimming pigs at Big Major Cay. Head to the sea park in Warderick Wells Cay, where you can hike Boo Boo Hill and see the natural blow holes or dive the oldest stromatolite reefs in the world. Head to the Abacos ,a boomerang-shaped chain of islands spanning 130 miles with a number of national parks and hundreds of tiny uninhabited cays, all perfect for a visit while on a sailing vacation to the Bahamas. See Elbow Cay’s candy-striped lighthouse, protected coral at Sandy Cay, Man-O-War Cay’s boat building history, the seven-mile beach at Great Guana Cay with its hog roast and Treasure Cay’s soft sandy beaches. This is a paradise for those who love marine life and spending time in the water snorkeling and diving. Check out our by the cabin cruises in the region . Belize Our brand new destination for 2019 reached a ranking, welcome to Bel ize . Our base at Robert’s Grove Marina in Placencia is situated between Mexico and Guatemala and is the ideal place to charter a bareboat yacht, where you can explore the world’s second longest barrier reef and some of the +450 uninhabited cays. Snorkel with eagle rays in Coco Plum Cay or search for the famous pirate Blackbeard at the Turneffe Atoll, where you can also swim with dolphins and manatees. No visit to Belize would be complete without a visit to Lighthouse Reef, home of the world famous ‘Blue Sinkhole’. The eerie hole is 1000ft wide and over 400ft deep and while you can’t sail in it, you’ll be able to see the various shipwrecks and 20ft stalactites that surround it. British Virgin Islands A firm favorite for Dream Yacht Charter customers, the British Virgin Islands . Separating the Atlantic and Caribbean oceans, the BVIs are a group of over 60 islands that sit at the base of the Lesser Antilles. Whether sailing bareboat or by the cabin , you’ll be sure to have one of the most amazing experiences when you sail the BVIs. Head to Jost Van Dyke Island and have a ‘Painkiller’ at the world famous Soggy Dollar bar or visit Willy T’s – a floating restaurant and bar that has recently undergone restoration and been rehoused in Grand H…

item.title: Five Sailing Vacations Where Sailing Experience Isn’t Required
item.description: You don’t need to be a sailor to experience a vacation on a sailboat. It’s our mission to help everyone feel the joy of seeing destinations from the water, island hopping and feeling the wind in your hair with sails at full mast. This is why we made sailing vacations easy with our organized by the cabin charters, where you can reserve a cabin. You can leave everything to us, from the itinerary to the sailing and cooking by our professional staff. All you need to do is just pick the destination where you want to go, book your flights and leave the rest to us. Need inspiration? We’ve got five exciting destinations to get your started… 1. Hop between the British Virgin Islands The BVIs are a group of impressive islands that separate the Atlantic Ocean from the Caribbean Sea and is known for its Caribbean atmosphere and beautiful beaches. This location is perfect for anyone who loves snorkeling, swimming and stand-up paddle boarding. You’ll be amazed by colors of the BVIs, the water is a shade of blue you have probably never seen before and the sunsets, with streaks of gold and magenta, will dazzle you. There is so much to see, from Jost van Dyke, Norman Island, Peter Island, Anegada, Virgin Gorda and Guana Island, plus many more. Find out more about our Tortola Dream 8 Days/7 Nights charter from our base in Scrub Island > 2. Spice up your vacations with a tour of Grenada Grenada’s chain of islands includes Grenada, Carriacou and Petite Martinique. Grenada is known as the “spice island” for a reason – it produces the aromatic spices such as ginger and cinnamon. Yet it’s also the spice of life of this country’s unique French and English culture that will engulf you the minute you arrive for your Tobago Cays Dream 8 Days/7 Nights cruise . The people of Grenada are warm and inviting and the beaches are world renowned. You will also be able to snorkel coral reefs among the five islands of the awe-inspiring Tobago Cays or pick up some gifts at St George’s markets. Your cruise itinerary includes: Boarding at Port Louis Marina Carriacou-Sandy Island Union-Mayreau Tobago Cays Petit St Vincent Prickly Bay 3. Enter the gateway to the Grenadines from Martinique Our Grenadines cruises start from Martinique and take you on an exciting adventure around these special Caribbean islands. Experience the many cultures, sounds and textures of Bequia, Mayreau, Tobago Cays, St Vincent, St. Lucia and Sainte-Anne in one vacation. Enjoy the coral barrier reef at Tobago Cays, optional lobster BBQs on the beach, visiting local markets and boutiques, listening to authentic steel bands or go on an excursion to swim at the foot of a waterfall. Discover everything you can do with a Dream Grenadines Premium 8 Days/7 Nights charter > 4. Vacation in Tahiti’s Society Islands The South Pacific island of Tahiti is famous for its exotic beauty, friendly local welcome and the charms of its traditional dances and drums. Kick back and enjoy islands with lagoons, lush landscapes and clearwater, home to a vast array of marine life, including vibrant coral, sea turtles, dolphins and rays. Kayak and paddleboard with Bora Bora, Raiatea, Tahaa, Huahine and Moorea as your backdrop for the perfect photo moment. A vacation in this special place is easy to organize with our by the cabin charter in Tahiti. Learn more about our Bora Bora Dream Cruise 8 Days/7 Nights > 5. Enjoy Thailand’s hongs and delicious food For the more adventurous travel lovers, Thailand is yours to discover. Get to know the country’s limestone landscapes in Phang Nga Bay and explore this Asian gem with our Phuket Dream Premium 8 Days/7 Nights charter. Let us transport you to a world of secluded anchorages, ancient ruins and Buddhist temples. Visit Koh Nakha Noii, Ao Thalin, Koh Hong, Koh Phi Phi Don, Koh Phi Phi Leg and many more. You might even see an elephant or two with a land excursion. What are by the cabin charters? Our all-inclusive by the cabin charters allow you to explore your destination of choice …
